waivers.verdict: Nothing to claim this week. The Richardson claim cleared Wednesday morning as planned — $23 spent, no drop, $38 left. Bowers returning to Questionable settles the TE spot without a wire move. Everything else on the wire is a pass.

lineup.verdict: Lineup is already set right. Cousins at SUPER_FLEX and Denver at defense are both in from Monday's moves, and Bowers is correctly back at TE now that he's Questionable instead of Out — nothing to change tonight.

trades.verdict: Hold. The trade deadline (Week 11) passed two days ago — no trade can be made for the rest of the season.

inactives.verdict: Not actionable today. No NFL games are underway or about to kick off — the first game of the week is Thanksgiving, tomorrow. This check runs again Sunday morning before the early games.
